title: tithymalus × peisonis
intro: Tithymalus × peisonis, commonly known as Euphorbia characias subsp. peisonis, is a hybrid plant species within the Euphorbiaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its ability to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its anti-inflammatory and analgesic effects. The bioactive constituents of Tithymalus × peisonis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. This plant is also used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, leveraging its therapeutic actions to provide relief and promote overall well-being.
